model.name: sprintMd.perTaskGeneration
model.description: generate-sprint-md emits ONE task-<slug>.md per Task unit (title, acceptance criteria, statusChecklist, chain) so every task's per-task MD file EXISTS and its detail-view link resolves HTTP 200 instead of 404; Task units must NOT set model.sourceFile to planning.md (which collapses all tasks into one shared view). The per-task MD is a generated VIEW (law #100), --check byte-match holds. Shipped v0.7.8.
model.note: Class/Method/Impl/Test to be wired by planner (r265 gate). Target Class = generate-sprint-md / SprintMdGenerator.
